description: Set when a post goes out: scheduled_at, or next_slot=true for each account's next free posting time (time_reason says why). Approved targets are scheduled now; drafts keep the time and go out once approved. To post at a clock time somewhere else (9:00 in Tokyo), pass timezone with a scheduled_at without an offset; the post keeps that zone, and a later change to the workspace's zone leaves it alone.

account_ids.description: Only these accounts' targets. Default: all.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

next_slot.description: Each account's next free posting time instead of scheduled_at.

post_id.description: ID of the post (a UUID): from post_list or post_create

scheduled_at.description: ISO 8601. With an offset (2026-11-02T09:00:00-05:00) it is that moment; without one (2026-11-02T09:00) it is that clock time in the post's time zone (timezone, else the workspace's), so daylight saving is handled for you.

timezone.description: The post's own time zone (IANA, e.g. Asia/Tokyo) for a post that should go out at a clock time somewhere else; null follows the workspace's. Left out, it stays as it is (a new post follows the workspace).

name: post_schedule
title: Schedule or reschedule
